newsitem.title: KENYA: Index falls at Nairobi bourse on new issue.
newsitem.headline: Index falls at Nairobi bourse on new issue.

text.p: The Nairobi Stock Exchange 20-share index eased on Friday as players waited for a new primary issue in Kenya Commercial Bank to hit the market, floor dealers and bourse officials said.
The index fell 17.13 points to 3049.84 while turnover was posted at 10.043 million shillings on 346,037 shares from 5.662 million shillings on 221,560 shares on Thursday.

Brokers said most investors were waiting by the sidelines for Kenya Commercial Bank to begin trading 11.88 million primary shares which the government is offloading -- in a measure that will reduce its stake to 60 percent from 70 percent.
The offer will be open between September 16 and October 15. Each share will be sold at a price of 50 shillings which is a 10 percent discount from the current 55 shillings.
A broker said most investors were waiting to buy from the government rather than the market as it will be cheaper.

A bourse official said: "Though there were no big lots dealt from the special board, the market's trading on average was good as there were very many small lots traded on the general floor prompting the turnover to advance compared to Thursday."

Financials led the market with Housing Finance trading very good volumes. Housing Finance traded 82,166 shares at 26, 25 and 25.50, National Bank of Kenya on 51,875 shares at 17.90, 17.60 and 17.65 from 17.90 and Kenya Commercial Bank eased to 54.50 from 55 on 17,303 shares.
Rea Vipingo eased to 11 from 11.05 while Sasini Tea & Coffee fell to 51 from 52.50.
African Tours & Hotels rose 3.0 to 245, CMC Holdings fell 2.0 to 61 while Kenya Airways traded 74,137 shares at 11.25, 11.10 and 11.20 from 11.15.

Dunlop Kenya rose to 260 from 257, East African Packing fell to 70 from 71 and Total Kenya rose 1.0 to 73. Officials said foreign investors dealt 55,000 shares of Firestone East Africa at 25 from 24.25.
